decisions.reason: Margin analysis draws directly on the firm's maintained tariff and market-data databases and its own R&D. That lets the firm read early results and refine the product cheaply, and it adds analytical value to the central platform.
Gas tariff comparison sits close to the core data-capture and calculation know-how and still has its own page. Its fit with the platform strategy outweighs the small risk of consolidation.

This multi-model regional calculator line builds on the firm's knowledge base and likely took over the role of the withdrawn electricity calculator C. Its low website visibility still leaves a moderate chance of further consolidation.
The area definition tool applies the firm's regional and network data expertise. It underpins the other location-based products, which makes it a useful building block for the integrated platform.
Site-specific tariff comparison uses the existing databases and sits close to the core business. Its overlap with B and its limited visibility imply a modest chance of being merged or withdrawn.
